summary: Seating of the initial Assembly by founding party assignment. No popular vote is held for the First Term.
method: Players are placed into four or six founding parties through a private intake process managed outside the public record; players have four days to request reassignment. Seats are then apportioned to party blocs, each capped at sixty seats.
notes: Results will be published here once the founding assignment is final.
No vote shares exist for a founding assignment.

summary: General election for the Second Term, held between terms and effective from Week 1 of the Second Term.
method: Each of the twelve regions is divided into single-seat constituencies; the leading party in each wins the seat. A global tier of 300 list seats adjusts party totals toward their share of the worldwide vote by the largest-remainder method; parties need two per cent of the global vote to qualify. Overhang seats are retained and enlarge the Assembly for that term.
notes: Results are computed by the published model, not narrated. Moderators may explain the main causes of changes in support without revealing hidden model parameters.
